name: OTel-Embedding-335M
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A finetune of BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5, not a new base model: same config.json, same 0.335 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-02-02. Caveat: the +37.5 pp NDCG@10 is measured on the held-out 10% of the same OTel-Embedding corpus the model was trained on - the card says so explicitly and warns it 'should not be interpreted as results from a fully independent external benchmark suite'. No out-of-domain or MTEB number is published. A sibling record otel-embedding-22m covers the MiniLM-based OTel model.

benchmarks.name: OTel telecom retrieval NDCG@10
benchmarks.config: Card table 'OTel vs. Base Model': base model 51.7% vs OTel fine-tuned 89.2% +/- 0.6, bootstrap n=1000, on the held-out 10% of the OTel-Embedding corpus the model was trained on (in-domain, not an external benchmark).
